Form No. 2
G. 2000-8-29

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Foreign Department Station,
No. F. O. D. 217
Date October 30, 1929）

Subject (in full) Comrade Gan.

Made by D.S. Maklaevsky. Forwarded by J.L. Givens A.C. (Pol)

Information has been received to the effect that
Comrade Gan, a Russian, member of the All Russia Communist
Party (B), recently arrived in Shanghai from Harbin and
resides at 80 Route des Soeurs. He is an important Soviet
Agent, highly educated and speaks good English.
In 1921-1922 while in Chita, Transbaikal Province,
Gan as a member of staff headquarters of the 5th Soviet
army was appointed interpreter to General Blucher alias
Galens, new Commander in Chief of the Far Eastern Soviet
Army. After the management of the C.E.R. was taken by
Soviet Russia Gan appeared in Harbin as interpreter to the
Committee of the board of Soviet Directors of the railway.
He is now employed by Claude Neon Lights Inc. at H. & S.
Bank Bldg, the manager of which is an American, Bruno Shwartz,
a friend of Mr. J.B. Powell, editor of the "China Weekly
Review." Shwartz in 1927 was editor of a newspaper with
bolshevik leanings in Hankow, which publication was subsidized
by Borodin.
（批：Gan's）His local activities are being watched.

D. Maklaevsky.
D. S.

Scy.

（批：HR. 30/10）

A/D. C. I.

报告

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
外务科巡捕房，
编号 F. O. D. 217
日期 1929年10月30日）

主题（全称）甘同志。

由 D.S. Maklaevsky 撰写。经 J.L. Givens 助理总监（警务）转发。

接获情报称，甘同志，俄国人，全联盟共产党（布尔什维克）党员，近期从哈尔滨抵达上海，居住于修女路80号。他是一名重要的苏联特工，受过良好教育，英语流利。
1921-1922年间，甘在外贝加尔省赤塔时，作为苏联红军第5集团军参谋部成员，被任命为布柳赫尔将军（化名加伦），即新任远东苏联红军总司令的翻译。在中东铁路的管理权被苏维埃俄国接管后，甘出现在哈尔滨，担任铁路苏联董事管理委员会的翻译。他目前受雇于位于汇丰银行大楼的霓虹灯公司（Claude Neon Lights Inc.），该公司经理为美国人布鲁诺·施瓦茨（Bruno Shwartz），是《密勒氏评论报》编辑鲍威尔先生的朋友。施瓦茨在1927年曾是汉口一家具有布尔什维克倾向的报纸的编辑，该出版物由鲍罗廷提供资助。
（批注：甘的）其在本地活动正受到监视。

D. Maklaevsky.
D. S.

Scy.

（批注：HR. 1929年10月30日）

助理刑事侦缉督察
